_meta.description: Look up a group by name and return its member count and member list. Navigates to /organization/groups, searches for the group, navigates to its detail page, and reads the membership data.

group_name.description: Name of the group to look up (partial match supported via search).

notes: TIER WARNING: Groups feature requires a Business plan on this YeshID account. The current org is on a free/trial tier — the groups table shows 'No data available' and the 'New Group' button is disabled.
This payload is forward-compatible: when groups are enabled, it will work without modification.
Group detail URL pattern: /organization/groups/{id} (UUID-based, discovered via find_row navigation).
Groups table columns observed: Group name, Type, Description, Owners, Actions.

2026-09-15: guard_tier became an assess_state branch that stops with the plan message; perceive steps became read; respond is a runtime action; s0 stops the run when group_name is missing (the 2026-07-11 run searched for the literal '{{group_name}}', WQ-180). Only the steps up to s3c can be verified on this org, which has no groups.

2026-09-15 live: the guard first read the table too early, because s3 waited on the search box, which exists at once; it now waits on the footer and judges by '0-0 of 0'. The run reached s5 and stopped with 'Row not found: Engineering', which is honest: this org has no groups.

search-input.resolveHint: Search input on the groups list page.

group-member-count.resolveHint: On the group detail page, find the member count. May appear as a badge, header stat, or table footer. Look for text near a 'Members' section heading.

group-members-table.resolveHint: Table of group members on the group detail page. Columns likely: Name, Email, Status.

chain.message: q04 needs the group_name param, for example --param group_name=Engineering.

chain.note: Checked after the first navigate, on the YeshID page itself. Until 2026-09-15 this guard was the first step, with onMismatch exit_with_error, which the runtime never implemented, so it never fired.

Wait until the footer shows a range, 'N-M of TOTAL'. Waiting only for the footer to exist was not enough: on 2026-09-15 the live run matched a footer left from the previous render in 3 ms and s3c judged the page before the count appeared.

One node, on purpose: a state graph's nodes are judged in alphabetical order, not the order written, so a two-node graph named 'groups-available' and 'groups-unavailable' always answered 'groups-available' (measured live 2026-09-15). Vuetify marks an empty table with tr.v-data-table-rows-no-data, so its absence means the table has groups; anything else routes to the branch.
Search for the group by name.
settle (was delay 1000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Click the matching group row to navigate to the group detail page.
settle (was delay 1000ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout

Member count from the members table's footer, 'N-M of TOTAL', the way q01 reads counts (2026-09-15; was a perceive of an abstract target, and perceive ignores targets). Unverified: this org has no groups.
The members table body's text (2026-09-15; was a perceive with extract: table_rows, which the runtime never implemented). Unverified: this org has no groups.
Return group name, member count, and full member list.
